data.name: Shibin
data.gender_notes: Shibin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shibi is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu God Shiva. Shiva is the supreme God of the Hindu trinity, representing creation, preservation, and destruction. Shibin is a name that signifies the prosperity and abundance bestowed by this powerful deity. The name Shibin carries the meaning “God of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Malayalam, Tamil. Parents who choose Shibin usually hope their child will grow to embody god of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine blessings and protection of Lord Shiva, the God of Prosperity and Destruction.
data.etymology: Shibin belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shibin total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Shibi was a legendary king who ruled over the Vidarbha region in ancient India. His story is told in the Puranas, and involves his act of self-sacrifice to save a bird from being killed by a hunter. This act earned him the name 'Shibi' which means 'one who offers himself to others'.

Another reference to the name 'Shibin' is found in the medieval Alappuzha region of Kerala, India. Here, 'Shibin' was the name given to a group of influential landlords who held significant political power in the region. This usage of the name is not connected to the Puranic legend.
